Deadline remains 2026-10-11T22:18:50Z (no extension); individual heavy gates <=10min. Finite focused fix stage only; report concrete blocker if unable. Record actual start/deadline, readiness timestamp, exact base/head/tree/branch, commands/runtime/source/artefact receipts and cleanup in one concise Polish final comment on THIS executor issue, land in_review on qualified delivery.
No push/PR/merge/deploy/cloud/publication, no shared manifest/lock/registrar/migration changes. UPVE-1872 inactive until affected gates PASS; UPVE-1874 deferred; UPVE-1873 prepare-only. This clarification stays within the existing local-test authorization; do not ask for another permission solely because the previous disposable resource was removed.

Never touch existing containers/DB/volumes or secrets, no cloud/paid resources or deployment. Bounded replacement only for completing authorized test gates, no indefinite retry/resource loop.
New finite continuation may run <=45min from actual author start, individual heavy gates <=10min, with explicit checkpoint and cleanup. The prior deadline belongs to the expired/stopped attempt and must not force a confirmation-only permission loop; record new stage start/deadline. After genuine prerequisites PASS, activate executor and serial integration, not historical completed reviews/triage or unaffected tests. If a substantive technical blocker persists, report exact failure and bounded proposal instead of blanket restart. Same six-role roster and original authors; at most one exact completion wait. Deliver a locally runnable integrated preview with durable paths/instructions and limitations when ready, preserving owner checkout and completed evidence.


## Current owner authorization — EXECUTE implementation now
Owner explicitly authorized execution in this conversation: "No to jazda z tym". This supersedes historical backlog-only/no-dispatch restrictions below for the playground implementation wave, NOT resource/deployment/push permissions. Begin actual work, not permission-request-only planning. Use existing effect-jobs six-role roster, Codex gpt-6.1-sol explicit medium; no new profiles/fallback. Authorized: local application implementation, isolated worktrees, local tests and Conventional Commits, task dispatch and canonical risk-based single-round review/triage/original-author fixes/affected gates. Not authorized: provisioning even free cloud resources, domain purchase, existing secret/.env reads/copies, npm publication, remote push/PR/merge or deployment. Request exact missing resource/budget or remote operation when ready, while continuing independent local work. Existing unrelated work/owner changes preserved. Existing local disposable database creation requires checking actual authorization; do not touch existing databases/containers. Source library runtime changes require a separately approved findings task; read-only app SQL must not bypass lifecycle.
Foundation UPVE-1863 first: preserve library at root; apps/website (docs + /jobs + API), apps/playground-worker (DO consumers/scenarios/providers), packages/playground-contracts (private shared definitions/schemas/DTO). No packages/core migration or Nx/Turborepo. This repository structure is owner accepted. Inspect healthy current checkout and instructions, establish pins and disjoint paths; don't reset/repair owner's Git checkout. Owner specified no frontend styling/framework preference; foundation may recommend a minimal compatible choice and record it, ask only for materially unresolved product decisions, not repeatedly request permission to implement accepted scope.
After contracts and shared registrars delivered, dispatch independent CF PoC, scenarios, read API, live, UI and admin-capability study within actual implementor capacity (typically up to six). UI/live may use frozen contracts and mocks while CF integration is qualified; no fake claims of hosted PASS. Dependencies are in descriptions, not native stage barriers: validate readiness explicitly. Executor depends on CF PoC+scenarios; mutations depend on capability study+read API+scenarios; serial integration follows ready slices. Do not activate deferred SQLite UPVE-1874; hosting UPVE-1873 is prepare-only until separately authorized deployment.
Finite stages: foundation/implementation checkpoints <=90min, individual heavy gates <=10min, bounded CF PoC <=45min before concrete blocker report. Coordinator uses exact-child native completion waits at most one useful pending control, not loops/watchdogs or fake 30-second LLM polling. Record actual run/session/tool start, exact snapshots, ownership, consumed-report cursors, next readiness condition and honest blockers. Check original sessions if platform EOF/failure before duplicate dispatch. Do not repeat completed work or old release/reviews. Require durable evidence for actual checks, local/workerd/hosted distinctions, and preserve known upstream strict Drizzle/CF/network limitations.



Integrate qualified CF connection path with real job definitions/handlers. Per queue named consumers, not one DO per job; map sandbox isolation without unbounded DO/queue proliferation. Implement safe create/launch/provider-control/reset commands, scheduled bounded generation when viewers exist, backlog/due/recovery wakeups and repair. Preserve authoritative PG lifecycle and provider idempotency ledger, context-safe services and finite concurrency.
Application-owned sandbox expiry/reset generations prevent late worker writes into new sandbox. Bounded cleanup respects jobs states, identity evidence and domain references; do not purge Pending/Active/Isolated using terminal cleanup or issue broad DELETE. Explain shutdown/retirement of expired work and report unsupported lifecycle gaps rather than bypassing. Notify live adapter after confirmed changes where possible; use reconciliation for missed/internal transitions. Diagnostics are synthetic app observations, not durable library eventlog.
Ownership: playground/server/commands/**, playground/consumers/**, playground/sandbox/** and integration tests; manifests/routes/migrations serialized through foundation owner. Acceptance: real PG end-to-end scenarios including delayed retry/recovery, reset races, isolation, limits, unattended stop and resumed viewing. Hosted CF qualification only with separate resource authorization.


Prerequisites (explicit DAG, not native scheduling):
- UPVE-1863: [playground/contracts] establish application boundaries and parallel ownership
- UPVE-1864: [playground/cloudflare] prove PostgreSQL-backed job execution in Durable Objects
- UPVE-1865: [playground/scenarios] model deterministic real-world jobs and fake providers

Authorization: backlog creation only. Unassigned; do not dispatch, provision even free resources, read/copy secrets, register a domain, publish packages, push/merge or deploy without separate owner authorization. Existing completed issues remain closed. Use canonical project workflow UPVE-1020 when execution is activated; no automatic review dispatch now. Preserve owner changes; inspect current library/source/package APIs, repository instructions and recursive ai-docs before implementation. Public playground is a separate application consuming effect-jobs, not admin features silently added to the library. No lifecycle UPDATE bypass or hidden fake library capabilities. Missing APIs become reproducible findings for owner decision.
Proposed ownership paths below are boundaries to finalize in foundation, not permission to choose an unapproved repository or overwrite existing files. One serial owner for shared contracts, dependency manifest/lock, route registrars, migrations and deployment configuration. Each parallel author gets isolated worktree and disjoint files. Handoff: exact base/head/tree, changed files, actual checks, limitations and durable evidence. No live payment/email/arbitrary outbound webhook; synthetic data only. PostgreSQL is authoritative; no plaintext/key leakage or cross-sandbox access.
